description: Create a Stripe Checkout session for a plan upgrade. Shows current plan and available upgrades. Pass plan_id ('pro' or 'scale') to get a checkout_url on checkout.stripe.com — the user pays there in the browser. The checkout_url is the direct payment page for the selected plan.

currency.description: Checkout currency. Defaults from locale (pl → PLN, otherwise USD).

locale.description: UI locale for the success/cancel return URLs (default en).

plan_id.description: Target plan ID. Required to create a Stripe Checkout URL.

name: upgrade_plan
title: Upgrade Subscription Plan
